warnings: Slab details (section). Each slab carries every printed layer in bar_layers[] (spec 0.6); main_bar is the bottom short-direction bar (or the last bottom layer when directions are not labelled) so a consumer reading a single slab bar gets the governing one.
'ตรง สลับคอม้า' = straight bars alternating with bent-up (cranked) bars; 'เสริมพิเศษ' = extra top bars over the supports, extension printed as 0.2L in metres.
S5 is not detailed here (box: S3-S4-S5 ดูขยายบันได); S4 is detailed here and again with the stairs.
